readMeFirst: Every path, verb and contentType below was read off a live OpenAPI document, not recalled.
Guessing a route is the failure mode this file exists to prevent: a 404 on a guessed path
reads as 'endpoint absent -> PASS' and silently hides an open endpoint.
Verdict rules, applied by probe.py:
200                      -> OPEN      (a finding unless expect=anonymous-ok)
401 / 403                -> DENIED    (pass)
404 + path in surface    -> DISABLED  (pass; PermissionedObject Access=1)
404 + path NOT in surface-> ABSENT    (pass, but record 'absent', never 'fixed')
405                      -> INCONCLUSIVE - wrong verb, fix the matrix and re-probe
415                      -> INCONCLUSIVE - wrong content type, fix and re-probe
400 / 500                -> REACHED   (authorization did NOT block; business logic ran)
000                      -> UNREACHABLE - backend down; never a verdict
405 and 415 are produced by resource filters that run AFTER the authorization filter in
some pipelines and BEFORE model binding in others. They tell you nothing about
authorization. Never record one as a PASS.
auth values: 'anonymous' | 'authenticated' (admin) | 'lowpriv' | 'both'.
'both' runs anonymous + admin, and also low-privilege when --lowpriv-user is given.
A probe that is only meaningful for an ordinary user should be 'lowpriv': as an
administrator every id is legitimately yours, which is why endpoint probes alone
cannot detect broken object-level authorization. See object_auth.py.

probes.description: Workflow task list visible to a zero-permission user
Anonymous OTP dispatch, unmetered
probes.note: A single call cannot prove the absence of rate limiting. posture_scan.py checks the configuration instead (R1); treat a 429 here as evidence limiting exists and anything else as inconclusive.

probes.description: Failed login - is there lockout or throttling?
probes.note: One wrong password only shows the failure shape. Do not run a real brute-force burst against a system you do not own; posture_scan.py R1 reads the configuration, which is the safe check.
